items.title: The problem with telling people the world is ending

items.title: 'No Kings' rallies push early voting ahead of US midterm elections
items.description: Organizers of the "No Kings" protests, known for their anti-Trump sentiment, are urging Americans to vote early in the November 3 midterm elections, as Republicans face tough races to retain control of Congress.
